items.title: Manny Albam interviewed by Monk Rowe, Tarrytown, New York, October 31, 1998
items.q: I don’t mean to demean Richard Rodgers

ctx.x: The following Monday. The reason for that is you can’t put out anything from a show until the original cast album hits the stores. And the publisher told him well the original cast album which they already recorded on the day that he’s talking to me, on Sunday, will be out on Monday. Now he said, “who do you want in the band, I’ll get all the guys you need” etcetera, etcetera. And some guys were unavailable so you can see that they’re — at any rate, I stayed awake from that Sunday morning until Thursday night…

had a copyist that was sitting across the desk from me and at one time I guess, because he told me this finally, I was writing like this, trying to — and I thought I was just whipping them out. And he looked at me and he picked me up and he said, “I’m going to put you in the shower.” And he put me in a cold shower and then the next four days. Now I never want to do this again, and it’s probably the most successful thing that I’ve done — that I had done up until that time. I got a Grammy nomination and everything.…
